Bleistiftbehälter - Ein Bleistift-förmiger Behälter

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1724774-pencil-container-a-pencil-shaped-container#profileId-1831063

It's a pencil shaped container that holds pencils, pastries, or anything else you feel you may need to store for the school year!

 

Are you a teacher and need to hide your snacks that help you cope with the hooligan children you attempt to educate? Well, look no further! This model's for you!

 

The files in the “Color Swap” folder are for those who have pause capabilities to be able to swap colors mid print to get the desired effect. The files in “Separate Parts” folder are for those who don't wish to worry about color swapping. Just glue all parts together

 

Printing Instructions:

* Layer height: 0.2mm
* Wall loops: 3 (for the lighter colors so not as much light shines through and makes the infill visible)
Thank you for your time and consideration on this matter.

 

Feel free to join my discord for additional support, questions, or suggestions!

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: Separate Parts - 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 10% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 3
- Infill: 10%
- Filament: PLA (#E8AFCF), PLA (#C8C8C8), PLA (#FEC600), PLA (#F7E6DE), PLA (#000000)
